description: This PHP source file defines the class `aowTemplateParser`, which extends the `templateParser` class. It provides a static method `parse_template` that processes a template string with data from bean objects, handling bean retrieval and cleanup within the SuiteCRM framework. The file is part of the modules/AOW_Actions and interacts with other SuiteCRM components such as BeanFactory and template parsing.

classes.name: aowTemplateParser
classes.description: A class extending `templateParser` that adds a static method to parse templates with bean data, ensuring beans are correctly fetched or refetched if needed, and handling special `Person` objects.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Static method that takes a template string and an array of beans identified by name and ID. It retrieves beans from the database, handles caching issues, processes the template with each bean, and finally adds contact information to the template.
